# `Q-5-55` — `quarto-required` Does Not Admit Quarto 2

> The `quarto-required` range in `_quarto.yml` admits no Quarto 2
> version.

## What this means

`quarto-required` holds a version range, and no Quarto 2 version
satisfies this one. Usually the range declares a Quarto 1 project:

```yaml
quarto-required: "^1.7"   # Q-5-55: Quarto 1.7 or a later 1.x
```

Quarto 2 renders the project anyway, but the output may differ from
what Quarto 1 produces. Less often the range admits no version of
either (`"^3"`).

## How to fix it

If the project has been moved to Quarto 2, declare that:

```yaml
quarto-required: "^2"
```

If it is a Quarto 1 project, render it with Quarto 1. To render it
with Quarto 2 as well without the warning, silence it in
`_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
diagnostics:
  Q-5-55:
    level: off
    reason: "a Quarto 1 project we render with both versions"
```

See [Declaring the Quarto version of a project](../../guides/projects/quarto-version.qmd).

## Related errors

- [`Q-5-53`](Q-5-53.qmd) — no `quarto-required` at all.
- [`Q-5-54`](Q-5-54.qmd) — the range admits both Quarto 1 and Quarto 2.
